WITH U AS( SELECT DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY T.BOARD_NO DESC) RNUM , T.*, D.DEPT_NM FROM ( SELECT A.BOARD_NO, A.BOARD_CODE_NO, A.BOARD_TITLE, A.BOARD_CN, A.BOARD_REG_DATE , A.BOARD_CNT, A.BOARD_STATUS, A.USER_NO , (SELECT B.USER_NM FROM TB_USER B WHERE B.USER_NO = A.USER_NO) USER_NM , A.FILE_GROUP_NO, A.BOARD_START , A.BOARD_END, A.FILE_SAVE_LOCATE, A.FILE_ORIGINAL_NAME FROM ( SELECT * FROM BOARD X LEFT OUTER JOIN FILE_GROUP Y ON(X.FILE_GROUP_NO = Y.FILE_GROUP_NO) LEFT OUTER JOIN FILE_DETAIL Z ON(Y.FILE_GROUP_NO = Z.FILE_GROUP_NO) ) A WHERE A.BOARD_CODE_NO = 3 ) T, EMPLOYEE E, DEPT D WHERE T.USER_NO = E.USER_NO AND E.DEPT_NO = D.DEPT_NO AND BOARD_STATUS = 1
) SELECT * FROM U WHERE U.RNUM BETWEEN (#{currentPage} * 10) - (10-1) AND (#{currentPage} * 10)
